examples.en: I just graduated from high school.

examples.text: Je n'ai jamais eu mon bac.
examples.en: I never graduated from high school.

examples.text: Ma fille a eu son bac l'an dernier.
examples.en: My daughter graduated from high school last year.

examples.text: Elle se décida à passer son bac.
examples.en: She made up her mind to graduate from high school.

examples.text: Les garçons sont encore en train de jouer dans le bac à sable.
examples.en: The boys are still playing in the sandbox.
